item.description:

item.title: odds jobs and endeavors
item.description:
0. assistant, queer tango (group & private lessons)
05/2024ish - (ongoing)

i almost forgot to list this one, since this isn’t one i actively really sought out or looked for. but it’s been a pleasure to do, and a priviledge to keep doing.

1. tech support, CG Jung Institute
09/2024 - 02/2025 (5 months)

helped various folks make sure their class was set up with zoom and the TV for presentations and meetings. after a while, getting up at 8am on Friday after a long week, just to help for half an hour on site, just wasn’t quite worth it anymore. i would often also get asked to help for a couple of prime weekend or holiday hours days before, and the scheduling for that just didn’t work out, either.

item.title: snapshots from 3 weeks home
item.description:
day 1: sunday, feb 17 – travel day

Most of the day spent traveling. Excited for a long period of waiting, of doing nothing, though flight was delayed and our landing was quite rocky. We attempted to land twice at Reagan, and finally diverted to Dulles. Mom & dad both came to pick me up, and dad made wonton soup for me – how savory it was, how much it hit the spot. 香啊！How sweet home is.
